text:
incident-bot: PAGER P1 — capacity-tier routing anomaly detected for tenant 'lumenpay'
incident-bot: detected sudden abnormal routing: portion of hosted traffic classified as dedicated and sent to dedicated-pool-us-west1 starting 2031-04-12T02:14:30Z. Symptoms: elevated 5xx, regional fallbacks, eviction churn.
arya: oncall ack. pulling routing diffs + variant registry.
phil: visual: https://console.redwood/alerts/routing/998271 - dedicated-pool-us-west1 eviction spikes and then fallbacks to eu-west-2. p95 latency for impacted tenants climbed from ~210ms -> 3.1s.
nguyen: infra-cd shows two related changes 02:05-02:10Z: routing-rules v2.21 and mapping-batch v7.0. routing-rules change adjusted evaluation order (priority inversion) and mapping batch added tenant->variant overrides.
kate: grep of active policy: new rule inserted with priority 200 matching header `x-sdk-tier` before `match: tenant.isolation`. That looks like precedence inversion.
ph1l: mapping CSV included `lumenpay,gptx-12k-ded` and `orbitals,gptx-12k-ded` — that dedicated variant only present in us-west1. EU clients were routed to eu-west-2 dedicated pool which then fell back -> eviction -> retry storms.
arya: runbook (short): 1) flip routing flag to ignore client-supplied tier hints 2) remove tenant overrides from mapping service 3) rollback routing-rules to pre-change if needed 4) throttle dedicated autoscale and enable eviction-protect 5) notify affected customers.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook action started.
arya: flipping flag now -> `infractl set routing.ignore_client_tier true --env prod` -> 02:17:11Z.
nguyen: removing tenant mapping entries for lumenpay and orbitals -> `curl -X POST https://internal-config/mappings/remove \n  -d 'tenants=["lumenpay","orbitals"]'` -> 02:17:42Z :white_check_mark:
phil: applying short-term autoscale throttle on dedicated pools: `scalerctl set-profile dedicated-shared --max-instances 28 --eviction-protect true` -> 02:18:05Z.
arya: rolling back routing-rules to commit 8a9d1 (pre-priority inversion) -> infra-cd triggered 02:18:30Z.
phil: edge strip for header as defence-in-depth: `edgectl strip-header X-SDK-Tier` -> 02:18:52Z. Some older proxies still inject `x-sdk-tier` with values though.
kate: monitoring: hosted->dedicated traffic volume dropping by 80% within 3 minutes. lumenpay error rate down from 46% -> 6% by 02:21Z. p95 latency returning to ~240ms.
accounts-bot: affected customers (02:14-02:20Z): lumenpay (SEV1 ~46% errors), orbitals (elevated latency ~12%), backbone-internal e2e failing. Tickets created: LUM-11001, ORB-5012. Account teams notified.
oncall-bot: oncall: arya primary, nguyen secondary. Handoff scheduled 02:25Z.
ph1l: odd: some synthetic checkers continue to create load because they cache DNS and keep hitting dedicated pool. We should add a short-term circuit-breaker to ignore dedicated binds from those agents.
arya: added simple CIDR block-based throttle for internal synthetic agents: `ratelimitctl add key=src_cidr:10.0.0.0/16 rate=50r/m` -> 02:22:10Z.
nguyen: rollback finished 02:22:30Z. Verified: routing-rule precedence restored so tenant-isolation evaluated before header matches. evictions dropping.
kate: root cause hypothesis: a single deploy bundled a precedence change (priority inversion) that made routing honor client-supplied tier hints ahead of tenant isolation plus a mapping import that assigned dedicated-only variants to several tenants. The combination allowed hosted traffic (including from older SDKs sending x-sdk-tier) to be misclassified as dedicated, then region-variant unavailability caused repeated cross-region fallback and eviction churn.
ph1l: mitigation summary: ignore_client_tier=true, tenant overrides removed, routing rollback applied, edge header strip, autoscale throttled, CIDR throttle for synthetic agents, accounts notified. Monitoring window 30m.
arya: drafting customer-facing note: "We experienced a routing configuration issue that misdirected a subset of your traffic to dedicated infrastructure, causing intermittent failures. We've reverted the configuration and applied mitigations. We're monitoring and will follow up with a post-incident report and recommended retry/backoff guidance." Approve?
accounts-bot: approve and sent to LUM-11001 & ORB-5012.
ph1l: post-incident action items: 1) CI gate to detect tenant->variant region mismatches on mapping imports 2) disallow precedence-changing routing rules and mapping imports in same deploy by default 3) add simulator that validates critical tenant routing paths pre-deploy 4) surface variant-region availability to routing service so it can avoid misrouting 5) alert: hosted->dedicated ratio >5% per tenant. Creating INFRA-9003, INFRA-9004, INFRA-9005.
arya: assigning postmortem owner: nguyen. RCA due by EOD. Scheduling RCA workshop 16:00 UTC.
nguyen: taking watch. I'll collect logs and own RCA.
ops-runbook-bot: Incident P1 mitigated -> mitigations applied. Watch 30m. Reopen if anomalies reappear.
arya: marking incident mitigated and closing live thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread closed by arya at 02:23:20Z
